title: The One Who Watches
old_p1: Long ago, cities had tall stone walls. A watchman stood high on the wall, looking far, far away over the land. If he saw danger coming, he blew a loud trumpet so everyone could get safe.
Heavenly Father told Ezekiel, “I have made you a watchman for my people.” Ezekiel would call out to help them stay safe.
old_p2: Many people had wandered away from Heavenly Father. So Heavenly Father gave Ezekiel kind words to call out: “Turn, turn, and live!”
To repent means to turn around, stop doing wrong, and come back to Heavenly Father. He does not want anyone to stay lost. He wants all His children to come home.
If you ever choose wrong, you can turn around and try again. Tonight you can feel safe, because Heavenly Father is glad when you come back.
p1: Long ago, cities had tall stone walls. A watchman stood high on the wall and looked far away. If he saw danger coming, he blew a loud trumpet to warn everyone.
Heavenly Father told the prophet Ezekiel, “I have made you a watchman for my people.” Ezekiel would warn the people, so they could be safe.
Many people had wandered away from Heavenly Father. They were doing wrong things.
p2: Heavenly Father wanted every one of them to come home. So Ezekiel did not stay quiet. He called out kind words: “Turn, turn, and live!” To turn means to stop doing wrong and come back. This is called repenting.
If you choose something wrong, you can turn around too. You can say sorry and try again. Heavenly Father is always glad when His children come back.
